name: Flute of Taming's [REST] champion +1 level ability
notes: Flute of Taming's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost is NOT exercised for the same FSM-click-bypass reason as entrancing-filigree-enter-banish. Ability 1 ([REST]: champion +1 level) is covered via the same AddGlobalEffects()-flag pattern used elsewhere; ability 0 (buff a target Animal/Beast ally) requires a subtyped ally target and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Your champion gets +1 level until end of turn.
